pattern.description: A full-size prompt dims to grey, then shrinks and reflows into a compact grey chat bubble; the phone frame and Gemini wordmark settle slightly, and the sparkle icon plus gradient placeholder bars appear below to signal the answer loading.
pattern.why_premium: The prompt never cuts away: the same words physically become the sent message, so the viewer tracks one object from 'asking' to 'sent'; the dim-then-shrink sequence and the immediate shimmer bars sell responsiveness without showing a spinner.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.prompt', {color:'#9a9a9a', duration:0.08, ease:'none'}) .to('.prompt', {scale:0.55, x:dx, y:dy, duration:0.35, ease:'power2.inOut'}) — or a Flip.from(state) when swapping the big prompt for the bubble layout — .fromTo('.bubble', {autoAlpha:0, scale:0.95}, {autoAlpha:1, scale:1, duration:0.3, ease:'power2.out'}, '<') .to(['.phone-frame','.gemini-wordmark'], {y:'+=10', duration:0.35, ease:'power2.inOut'}, '<') .fromTo(['.sparkle','.bar-1','.bar-2'], {autoAlpha:0}, {autoAlpha:1, duration:0.25, ease:'power2.out', stagger:0.06}, '-=0.1').
build_hint.remotion: const t = interpolate(frame, [2, 13], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateLeft:'clamp', extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); prompt scale = interpolate(t,[0,1],[1,0.55]), translate toward bubble position; bubble opacity = t; placeholder opacity = spring({frame: frame - 14, fps, config:{damping:200}}) staggered by 2 frames; no overshoot.

notes: No SFX candidates. The prompt-to-bubble transform could also be read as a crossfade between two text layouts (large text fades while bubble text fades in) rather than a true scale morph; frames f457-f461 suggest a dim then reflow. Phone frame/wordmark shift is small; camera.move is none.
